scenes.narration: In Morocco's Rif Mountains, a whole town is painted blue, and nobody agrees why. The town sits high on the hillside, and its alleys climb steeply between blue walls.
Some residents say the blue stands for peace. Others say it keeps mosquitoes away.
One commonly cited explanation links the blue to Jewish communities who settled here, though the exact origin is not firmly documented.
Residents continue repainting their walls, keeping the town's famous blue streets vibrant. From pale sky blue to deep indigo, almost every corner looks different.
So what's the real reason? Tell me your theory in the comments.
